description: This source file defines the code-behind for the Leaderboard page of an online examination system. It handles session management, user verification, database query to retrieve user semester information, and navigation between different pages such as login, dashboard, and user profile.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Leaderboard ASP.NET Web Form page, managing session, database connection, and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; verifies user session, retrieves user semester info from database, and stores it in session.
